ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white/light-grey mottled pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white speckling and mottling concentrated along the upper sub-marginal regions of both lobes; the lower central and peduncle-adjacent areas are characterized by contiguous solid black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 35 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations with sharp peaks and valleys (5-20 pixel depth) across the entire longitudinal boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the superior margin of both lobes, transitioning to a sharp, upward-pointing taper at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups located exclusively on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically oriented light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal tips and a significantly jagged, irregular trailing edge profile indicative of persistent mechanical or environmental wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific high-density white speckling pattern located approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip on the left lobe.
